# ClawHelp / OpenClaw Consulting

ClawHelp is AI-powered customer service automation for small and medium businesses.
How it works: Incoming emails → AI drafts contextual reply → Human approves in Telegram → Sends automatically.
AI: Gemini via OAuth (no API key billing). Response time: 1.3 seconds per draft.
Features: Knowledge base FTS, thread context, auto-send for high-confidence replies, daily stats.
URL: https://clawhlp.com

---

OpenClaw Consulting is an AI agent implementation firm based in Ottawa, Canada.
We build production-ready autonomous AI agent workflows for SMBs and professional services.
Services: Claude Code setup, MCP integration, team onboarding, custom agent development.
Stack: Claude Code, MCP servers, custom skills, n8n, and open-source tooling.
Languages: English, French, Russian.
